label: Feed Entry
description: An entry from an Atom, RSS or JSON Feed, as the RSS connector reads it: a bookmark whose title and description are plain text and whose body keeps the feed's markup, with the entry's id in its feed and the feed's origin and identity hash beside the bookmark's fields. The body is the entry's content, or its summary where that holds markup and the feed gives no content; the description is the summary as plain text, or the caption of its picture where the summary is only a picture. The image is the entry's image enclosure, else the first picture in its content or summary, else its media thumbnail.

entry_id.description: The entry's id in its feed: its Atom id, RSS guid, RSS 1.0 rdf:about or JSON Feed id, else its link.

feed_origin.description: The origin of the feed's address: its scheme, host and port, without the path or query where a private feed carries its token.

feed_hash.description: A hash of what identifies the feed in the connector's configuration, its name there or else its address, the same for every entry of one feed, which names the feed where its address may not go.
